posts.title: AI is a muscle
posts.excerpt: Even though AI tools are everywhere now, I still catch myself approaching problems the old way. The biggest unlock isn't learning every feature — it's remembering to ask.

posts.title: AI isn't replacing engineers. It's changing what makes one valuable.
posts.excerpt: Our value is becoming less about writing every line of code ourselves and more about understanding the bigger picture — making smart decisions, reviewing what AI produces, and knowing when to trust it.

posts.title: Finding Purpose in the Small Wins
posts.excerpt: I overheard two patients in the waiting room: "The waiting room is a lot nicer now, huh?" It might seem like a small moment — but it was a reminder of why I do what I do.

posts.title: Almost Got Scammed — And Didn't Even Know It
posts.excerpt: I referred a recruiter to a workmate who was job hunting. The "recruiter" sent him code to run as part of a "technical screening." His OS flagged it as a threat. He stopped just in time.

posts.title: First time at the YGG Play Summit — and wow.
posts.excerpt: After nearly a year working remotely, finally meeting the team in person reminded me that behind every pull request and late-night deployment, there are passionate people building with purpose.
